tei:div.tei:p: 425)༄༅/ rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don dang dmigs rim sbrel tshul bla ma'i zhal lung bzhugs so/ 426)

gzhi gnas rang byung ye shes che// mngon sum rang zhal ston pa po// rdo rje 'chang dang mi gnyis pa'i// ngag gi dbang po gtsug tu mchod/ de la 'dir sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don dmigs rim gyi tshig ris cung zad re rgyas su gtong tshul la/ nangs par gnyid sad ma thag mal nas har gyis ldang*/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal/ sems gnad kun slong legs par bcos/ thor thun la bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin lta bus ngag byin gyis brlab/ bla ma snying dbus su bzhugs pa spyi bor byon pa la/ gsol 'debs gnad smin dang*/ bla ma 'od du zhu bas bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi rtogs pa rang gi rgyud la skyes snyam pas 'das pa'i rjes mi 'brang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa 'phro mi mthud par ci gnas su bzhag rnam rtog zhig ldang bar rtsom pa na thun mong gi blo sbyong bya ba ni/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka': ci dang ci la skyes 427)kyang mi rtag 'chi: dge ba chos la 'bad na sangs rgyas rgyu: sdig pa gang byas da lta'i rigs drug 'khyams: yi dwags bkres skom dud 'gro blun po dang: dmyal ba tsha grang mi skye rga na 'chi: lha min 'thab rtsod lha yi sdug bsngal yod: zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dal 'byor rnyed bsam pa ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/ kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong pa// lku+ugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' ma log gnas la dad// 'di lnga rang gi 'byor pa yin// sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o/ 428) /skyes bu tshul khrims rkang pa chag gyur na// sbyin pas longs spyod ldan yang ngan 'gror ltung*// rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi /bu gar ru sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi nyid shin tu rnyed dka' gsungs// ngan song gsum ni sa yi rdul tsam la// mir skye ba ni sen mo'i rdul tsam mo// dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'// skyes bu'i don grub 'thob par 'gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma sgrub na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/

'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye mchi gar la blta dang mtshungs// skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// bsags pa kun gyi mtha' mdzad cing*// mthon po rnams ni dma' lhung 'gyur// 'phrad pa'i mtha' ni bral ba ste// gson po'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin// gsod par khrid pa'i bcon bzhin du/ 429) /gom re bor bzhin 'chi dang nye// skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod// dar ba yod na rgud pa yod// lang tsho de yang mi rtag ste// dar ba'i mdog kyang nad kyis 'phrog /'tsho ba'i tshe yang 'chi bas 'phrog /rtag pa'i chos ni gang yang med// gang du gnas kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i// sa phyogs de ni gang du'ang yon min te// bar snang na med rgya mtsho'i gting na'ang med// ri bo rnams kyi phrag na'ang yod ma yin/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa ni/ las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs las// de yi 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas// las kyi rgyu 'bras med par gang 'dod pa// de ni mu stegs chad par blta ba yin// shi ma thag tu mnar med dmyal bar skye// de yis rang phung gzhan yang brlag par byed// me ni grang bar 'gyur yang srid// rlung ni zhags pas zin yang srid// nyi zla thang la lhung yang srid// las kyi rnam smin bslu mi srid/ khyod kyi bram ze dge slong lha dang ni/ 430) /mgron dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang*// 'khor gyi slad du sdig pa mi byas ste// dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis// sdig pa'i las rnams spyod pa 'ga' yang ni// de yi mod la mtshon bzhin mi gcod de// 'chi ba'i dus la bab na sdig pa yi// las kyi 'bras bu gang lags mngon sum 'gyur/ dge ba'i phan yon la bsam pa ni/ yi ge bri mchod sbyin pa dang// nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton bya ba dang*// de sems pa dang bsgom pa ste// spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni// bsod nams phung po dpag med thob// dus su sbyin pa sbyin byed na// shi yang de ni shi ma yin// rgyags bzang ba yi mgron po bzhin// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// spos sam mar me gcig tsam mam// me tog gcig tsam mchod byas na// mi g.yo'i zhing der skye bar 'gyur/

sdig pa'i nyes dmigs la bsam pa ni/ chags dang zhe sdang 431)gti mug dang*// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun// de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do// zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar 'phen// chags pas yi dwags 'jig rten 'gro// rmongs pas phal cher dud 'gror 'gro// ldog pa lha dang mi nyid do/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsam pa ni/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi bzod pa// bkres skom grang dang dro dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo// yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni// zla ba tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang*// ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur de dag gis// bltas pa tsam gyi klung yang skam par 'gyur/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la// lto ba ri rab gtos tsam bkres pas nyan// mi gtsang gyi na bor ba chung ngu yang*// btsal ba'i mthu dang nus pa ma mchis so// dud 'gro'i 432)skye gnas na'ang gsod pa dang*// bcing dang rdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa'i// gzhir gyur dge ba spong ba rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ kha gcig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang*// sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar gyur// dbang med gzhan dag mtshon cha rnon po dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus btab ste brdeg cing bkol// sems can nyes pa'i las la spyod pa rnams// yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang*// bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa// dmyal ba rnams su rab tu sdug bsngal 'gyur// 'os yang ma yin char yang mi phod do// dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang*// dran nam klag gam gzugs su bgyis pas kyang*// sdug bsngal skye bar 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i// rnam smin nyams su myong na smos 433)ci dgos// de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad la// bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni// ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur par// de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro// mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams// lha rnams bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor bar khab kyi rtse tsam gyi// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong ba na// skyo ba'i sems ni rab tu bskyed/

khams gsum btson ra 'jigs pas na// brtson pa'i sems kyis spang bar bya/ zhes brjod cing don yid la dran/ der skyes pa'i sems can pha mar gyur pa rnams sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa ni thar pa'i gru gzings las/ kyai ma/ 'khor ba thar med rgya mtsho'i dong ring du// gti mug ma rig las kyis mnar ba yi// 'gro rnams bde ba 'dod phyir sdug la spyod// thabs la mi mkhas rmongs rnams snying re rje// las sgrib sdug bsngal 434)bral bar byin gyis rlobs// gzung 'dzin gyis bcings btson rar 'gro 'di dag /ri dwags rgyar chud slar 'jug ji bzhin du// gti mug can rnams 'gro drug grong khyer 'dir// yang nas yang 'khor 'gro rnams snying re rje// rigs drug 'khor ba stongs par byin= sdug bsngal ci cam mthong yang mi 'jigs pa'i// snying sran can rnams mi tshe yengs skabs zad// blo gtad med par ma shes 'khor ba 'dir// slar zhen skyid 'dod mi tshe yengs skabs zad// mi rtag zhen log dran par byin= phyi snod 'jig rten nang bcud sems can dang*// na ning da lo nam zla'i stod smad dang*// zhag re nyin mtshan skad cig 'gyur ba la// bsam gzhig btang na rang nyid 'chi bas gtugs// skyo shas snying rus nus par byin= dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan 'di rnyed dka' yang*// 'chi bdag nad kyis btab tshe chos med rnams// rin chen gling phyin stong log snying re rje// bdag sogs 435)'gro kun 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi// gnas las da lta thar bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes brjod do/ de nas thun min sngon 'gro la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal gdab pa ni/ khrid 'bring po las/ mdun gyi gzhi 'dir yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po: mtha' ma ne'u gsing dang gser gyi bye ma brdal ba: chu bya sna tshogs kyis skad snyan par sgrog cing rin po che dang me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa:

mtsho'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma'i sdong po yal 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas shing 'bras bu la bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad sogs rin chen tshogs su 'khrungs pa'i rtser: rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las grub pa'i me tog pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa rgya khyon stong gsum dang mnyam pa gcig bsgom: de'i ze'u 'bru dang 'dab ma bzhi la rin po che'i khri re re bsgoms pa'i khri dbus mar: pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i chos sku kun tu 436)bzang po sku mdog mthing ga mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can: rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing yum kun tu bzang mo dang gnyis su med par 'khril ba: de la rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum: drug pa rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i sangs rgyas grangs med pas bskor ba thams cad yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa: de'i steng gi cha la rgyal ba dgongs rgyud: rig 'dzin brda rgyud: gang zag snyan rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang: rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad: bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga: rig 'dzin gter ston brgya rtsa la sogs pa thams cad: sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing: phyag ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'dzin cing: stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang: glang chen gyi pags pa'i bla gos can: bro khrig khrig gar khyug khyug mdzad nas skal ldan byin gyis rlob pa'i dgongs pa la bzhugs pa: g.yas kyi khri la ston pa shākya thub pa la: 'khor sangs rgyas rabs bdun skal bzang gis sangs rgyas stong 437)rtsa gnyis thams cad sprul sku'i cha lugs chos gos gsum gyis klubs shing sa gnon mnyam bzhag can: mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan cing 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba: rgyab kyi khri la sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde drug gi mdo rgyud thams cad dang khyad par bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi thams cad bka' po ti glegs bam gyi tshul du gser gdong khra chem me bzhugs pa:

g.yon gyi khri la gu ru pad+ma sam bha dge slong gi cha lugs skyabs sbyin pad phor 'dzin pa la: nye sras brgyad dang sems dpa' bcu drug la sogs pa dang lam la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang: nyan thos mchog brgyad rang rgyal bcu gnyis 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug dgra bcom khri drug stong bzhi brgya la sogs pa theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun thams cad do: byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni lha bu gzhon 438)nu'i tshul can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa: nyan thos thams cad dbu reg zhabs rjen chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba'o: mdun gyi khri la rang re bod kyi lha skal yi dam thugs rje chen po la: 'khor bka' dgongs phur gsum la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po drug gi lha tshogs thams cad dang: de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang dhāk+ki: ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning sde lnga la sogs mgon chen bzhi bcu rtsa lnga: dpal ldan lha mo dpon g.yog sprul pa yang sprul stong rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur: de nas gzhung tshig gis gsal 'debs pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' kun tu bzang po= bskor: ces brjod/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ kun bzang rgyal ba= sogs nas/ skyabs su mchi: zhes dang*/ thar pa'i gru gzing las/ na mo/ dus gsum rgyun chad med par= sogs nas/ 439) shar grol thog mtha' med par skyabs su mchi/ zhes grangs ci nus dang*/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes pa grangs bsag mthar khrid 'bring las/ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad: pha mas thog drangs sems can thams cad la bsngo'o: de'i dge bas sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du 'thob par gyur cig:

zhes dang*/ dge ba ma rgan 'gro drug kun la bsngo: zhes lan gsum/ khrid 'bring las/ nam mkhar bsgoms pa'i skyabs yul thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas: 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og dam par tshud par gyur: ces brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ khrid 'bring las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul thams cad sprin 'khrigs pa lta bur bsgoms la: sangs rgyas kyi 440)zhing thams cad nas kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med kha ba bu yug ltar byon nas: mdun gyi bskyed pa de rnams la thim par gyur: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: dkar gsum mang ra gsum bdud rtsis mchod: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: sdig sgrib nyams chag thams cad bshags: dge bsod kun la rjes yi rang: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'tshal: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro ba sems can ma lus kun: kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog: bla ma dang dpal kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' gang ba'i mdun du: stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bye ba phrag brgya: de'i steng du bdag dang pha mas 441) gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi dge rtsa thams cad bsdus te: mchod pa'i sprin 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur yid kyis dmigs nas: bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i chos sku kun tu bzang po rgyal ba rigs lnga sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la: byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul lo: bla ma kun bzang dbyer med la: 'jig rten rin chen maṇ+ḍal steng: pha mas gtso byas sems can kun: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams: thams cad bsdus te bkram par bya:

kun bzang lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya: de thob nas sems can thams cad kyang bdag kho nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya: de'i ched du dpal kun tu bzang po la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba'i drung nas byang chub tu sems bskyed do: kun bzang rgyal 442) ba sras bcas thams cad la: bdag ni rtse gcig yid kyis skyabs su mchi: sems can don du byang chub sems bskyed do:

zhes lan gsum/ thar pa'i gru gzings las/ na mo/ 'gro ba kun don= sogs nas/ brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mjug dga' ba sgom pa ni/ khrid 'bring las/ deng nas byang chub sems dpa'i grangs su tshud cing: lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal ba'i gnas su gyur ba yin: mi lus thob pa don dang ldan: rnyed pa chen po thob pa yin no: mdun gyi nam mkhar bskyed pa'i kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa sems bskyed yul gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur: tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can tham cad bde ba dang= sogs nas/ btang snyoms chen po'i ngang la gnas par gyur cig zhes brjod/ bde sdug gtong len ni/ khrid 'bring las/ rang gi sna bug nas rlung phar 443)rgyu ba'i tshe: rang gi bsod nams dang dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa de thams cad sems can thams cad la sib kyis thim pas: sems can thams cad bde ba tshad med pa dang ldan par bsgom: rang gi sna bug nas rlung tshur rngub pa'i tshe: sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par rang la sib kyis thim pas sems can tham cad sdug bsngal tham cad dang bral bar bsgom mo: maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la tshogs zhing gsal gdab ni/ khrid 'bring las/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rgyan rta babs chos 'khor dang bcas pa: gru bzhi sgo bzhi la sogs pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa: rgya khyon stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i dbus su: rin po che'i khri lnga tshom gyi dbus mar bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i chos sku kun tu bzang po la rigs lnga yab yum dang: rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa 444) longs sku'i sangs rgyas tham cad dang: de'i steng du rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu: g.yas kyi khri la ston pa shākya thub pa la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong:

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul sku'i cha lugs: rgyab tu sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde drug gi dam chos thams cad glegs bam gyi tshul: g.yon du gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa nye sras brgyad sogs byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang: nyan thos mchog brgyad rang rgyal bcu gnyis: gnas brtan bcu drug sogs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun: mdun gyi khrir yi dam thugs rje chen po la 'khor bka' dgongs phur gsum la sogs rgyud sde drug gi lha tshogs thams cad dang: bar mtshams rnams su gnas dang yul gyi dpa' bo dang dhāk+ki chos skyong zhing skyong thams cad khrom ltar tshogs par bsgom: de dag thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga: hūm̐ 445)las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par sgom la: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du bzhugs par gyur: yig brgya brjod cing maṇ+ḍal phyis/ tshom bu 'god cing maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma 'bul ba dang*/ de nas sku gsum maṇ+ḍal ni/ khrid 'bring las/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi: gling bzhi gling phran brgyad: nyi zla ri rab sum brtsegs: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang: brgya byin lha'i longs spyod: gling bzhir 'khor los bsgyur rgyal mi'i dpal 'byor dang: gzhan yang rang gi bsod nams dge tshogs ci yod pa'i dngos po de thams cad mchod pa'i sprin byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin lta bus bkang ba: de lta bu bye ba 'bum phrag tu yid kyis sprul pa dang: dngos su yang 'jig rten gyi khams su bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i rin po che'i ri bo 446)dang: lha'i bdud rtsi la sogs pa thams cad dpal kun tu bzang po rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la 'bul lo: rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs nas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul:

zhes dang*/ thar pa'i gru gzings las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snod bcud stong gsum= sogs nas/ sprul sku'i zhing du skye bar shog zhes brjod/ khrid 'bring las/ rang gi pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi: rgyu ma lcags ri khor yug: sgal tshigs ri bo mchog rab: mgo bo rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang: rkang lag bzhi gling bzhi: mig nyi zla: rna ba sgra gcan dang dus me: sna gter gyi bum pa: lce 'dod 'jo'i ba: rkang sor bcu phyi'i lha mo bcu: lag sor nang gi lha mo bcu: tshigs chen brgyad bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad: don snod rgyal srid sna bdun: skra dang ba spu lha ma'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa: rang bzhin lhun grub tu bsgoms te: bla ma 447) kun bzang rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul lo: gru gzings las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang lus rtsa khams= sogs nas/ longs sku'i zhing du skye bar shog zhes brjod/ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi la/ snang bzhi la sogs rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad tshom bu'i tshul du bkod de/ bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul lo/ zhes dang*/ gru gzings las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sems nyid chos sku= sogs nas/ pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus= ma grangs bsag mthar khrid 'bring las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs pho brang gdan dang bcas pa 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ku sā li'i tshogs bsags ni/ dmigs rim zur bkol las/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug 'bring po tsam phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yar sne spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga had por yod pa/ mar sne lte 'og tu phug rdugs su 448)yod pa zhig stong seng nge bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gar rang gi rnam shes bla tshe bsod nams rlung sems thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig bsgom/ phaṭaḥbarjod pas spyi bor rgyangs se song*/ phaṭaḥbarjod pas de rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar la lang tsho rgyas pa/

zhal gnyis kyi rtsa zhal khro mo/ de steng phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pa/ gcer bu rus rgyan dang thod pa skam rlon gyis spras pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bskyil ba/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wam̐ ga bcug cing pad nyi ro gdan la zhabs gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rgya sran tsam zhig bsgom/ phaṭaḥ brjod pas de cher song mdzub gang tsam du gyur/ phaṭaḥ brjod pas de cher song khru gang tsam du gyur/ phaṭaḥ brjod pas phag mo'i sku de gnam sa gang ba gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas phyag g.yas gri gug de tshad tsam gyis rang gi bem po de'i 449) mgo bo bregs nas g.yas dngos su bzhag ste/ gri gug gi rtse tshad tsam gyis mgo bo'i pags pa bshus te/ ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum tsam/ dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa gcig tu gyur/ de'i nang du rang gi bem po de bzhag nas rang gi phyag g.yas kyis gri gug tshad tsam gyis sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog 'o ma lta bur ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan pa/ de nyid zos sam 'thungs ba tsam gyis sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad sel cing zag med kyi bde bas lus sems tshim nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam/ de nas phaṭaḥdang pos rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs nam mkhar sprin dpung du 'thibs/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad spyan drangs bar snang du na bun bzhin du 'khrigs/ yul lha gzhi bdag bgegs 450)rigs gnod byed dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad bkug nas sa gzhi gang bar khrom du 'tshogs par bsgom/ phaṭaḥ gnyis pas rang gi thugs ka nas rdo rje phag mo rang 'dra ba grangs med pa phyag g.yas rim po che'i skyogs dang g.yon bhan+dha 'dzin pa 'phros te/

bdud rtsi de la skyogs dang bhan+dhas bcus nas la las rtsa rgyud bla ma grub chen brgyad cu rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs mchod pas/ dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang*/ phaṭaḥ ces rgyud sde drug gi yi dam thams cad mchod pas/ thugs rgyud rab tu dgyes te tshogs rjogs/ phaṭaḥ ces gnas dang yul gyi dpa' bo dhāk+ki ye shes kyi chos skyong thams cad mchod/ phaṭaḥ ces dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs thams cad mchod pas thugs dam bskangs nas phyi nang gi bar chad zhi/ phaṭaḥ brjod pa yul lha gzhi bdag spyi dang khyad par sa skor de'i lha 'dre mchod pas dga' mgu yi rangs te gnod 'tshe mi byed par sdong grogs byed par bsam/ phaṭaḥ ces rigs drug gi sems can der 'dus 451)pa rnams dang ma 'dus pa so so'i gnas su bdud rtsi byin pas/ so so'i sdug bsngal las thar nas bde ba dang ldan par gyur/ phaṭaḥ brjod pas tshe rabs thog med nas lus srog zas nor gyi lan chags yod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la sbyin pas bu lon 'khor/ lan chags byang*/ gnod byed so so'i re 'dod bskangs te dga' mgu yi rangs nas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bsgom/ de nas/ phaṭaḥgasum gyis dang pos mgron thams cad rab tu mnyes shing tshim nas bzhad gad di ri ri bsgom/ gnyis pas spyan drangs pa'i mgron rnams so so'i gnas su song bar bsgom/ gsum pas bdag dang lus dang mgron thams cad rmi lam ltar dngos por ma grub pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ ces brjod do/ de nas sgrib sbyong la/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yul gsal gdab pa ni/ khrid 'brel chen mo las/ mdun du rdor sems sku mdog dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje: thugs kar 'dzin 452) cing g.yon pa yis: dril bu dkur brten zhabs sems skyil: sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol: rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ru: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni:

rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par bskyed: mgrin par rig 'dzin lha tshogs gsal: klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su: khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: khrid 'bring las/ de ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la dam pa rigs brgya rdzogs pa dam ye dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i drung du bdag gis lus grangs med du sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing sdig pa bshags par bgyi'o/ yar bzhengs nas brkyangs phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ na mo mañju shrī ye/ na mo su shrī ye/ na mo ud+da ma shrī ye swa hā/ zhes phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs dang*/ khrid chen las/ oṃ: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas: rdor sems thugs dang gang 'gal ba: bshags bgyi badz+ra satwa hūm̐: oṃ:sku yi 453)dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: āḥgasung gi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐:thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces dang*/ gsang rdzogs rgyud las 'byung ba'i zhi khro bshags chung gi bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ sogs nas/ yig brgya bcas phyag 'tshal/ mthar khrid 'bring las/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod nas thang la 'dug ste mnyam par bzhag/ de nas rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ khrid 'bring las/ rang tha mal ba'i spyi gtsug khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar: pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la: hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las: bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston kha'i zla ba ltar dkar ba: zhal gcig 454) zhi zhing 'dzum pa: phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin zhingaḥ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa: rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan dang snyan cha gdub bu do shal la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang: dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang dar sna lnga'i sham thabs dang cod paṇa can:

zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa: de'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum dang: de'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar yi ge drug pa dang de mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba: de las 'od zer 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs te rdo rje sems pa la thim pas: thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sku lus ltem gyis gang: lhag ma zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas ngang na ra ra babs: rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs: lus phyi nang gnyis ka nas babs shing bkrus pas: 455) nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par rkang mthil gnyis dang bshang lam nas nag nu ru ru thon te sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu mar song bas: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje kha gdangs pa'i nang du song bas ngoms shing tshim: bdud rtsis rang ltem gyis gang bas lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa ltar dkar seng nge gyur: rang gi spyi bor rdor sems= sogs nas/ nag nur song: zhes gter gzhung las 'byung ba dang*/ gru gzeng las/ rang nyid tha mal= sogs nas/ nag nur song: yig brgya grangs bsag satwa brgya tsam bzla/ bshags chung ni/ ho/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs= sogs nas/ sgo gsum bag med dam nyams bshags/ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing*/ khrid 'bring las/ spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas: rigs kyi bu'am: rigs kyi bu mo khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par yod do: zhes gsungs pa dang lhan cig rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas: 456) rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar gyur pas: rang tha mal gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus 'di nyid ye shes kyi lus su gyur te: rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog kar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs dkar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa:

dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par gyur: ces dang gter gzhung las/ mthar ni rdor sems rang thim rang rdor sems: zhes brjod/ khrid 'bring las/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po la yi ge drug dang yi ge brgya pas bskor ba: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs: lus bdud rtsis gang bas: sdig sgrib las nyon gyi sgrib pa dang bag chags phra zhing phra ba thams cad kyang ba spu'i sgo nas nag nyil gyis phyir thon: slar yang 'od zer dkar po ba spu'i sgo nas phyir song nas phyogs bcur 'phros pas: sems 457) can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyang bar gyur: yig brgya gsum tsam dang*/ yig drug brgya rtsa brjod/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu ste sngags phreng dang zla dkyil la thim: de hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ zhabs kyu nas gyen rdzogs su yal nas: ci yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur: zhes dang*/ bshags chung las/ yid kyi dam nyams lta bas bshags/ sogs nas/ bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med grol/

zhes brjod/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur= sogs brjod/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ khrid 'bring las/ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba'i spyi gtsug khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar: bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal 'dzum zhing spyan zhi ma khro: mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa: dbu skra sil mas sku rgyab non zhing: dbu 458)gtsug tor gyi steng du pad zhwa pad+ma mthong grol gsol ba: za 'og gi phod kha stag gi gong lag can gyi steng na chos gos rnam gsum klubs pa: rin po che'i snyan cha dang mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub gsol ba: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar 'dzin zhing: g.yon ye shes kyi ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng du 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa: gru mo g.yon na yum rdo rje phag mo kha ṭ+wam̐ gi tshul du dku la brten pa: zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gi lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa: 'or zer nyi ma 'bum las lhag cing srid gsum zil gyis non pa: de'i sku mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni dge 'dun dkon mchog: gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni chos dkon mchog: thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog: yon tan dang dngos grub mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni yi dam: phrin las dang nus 459) mthu mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong ste: thams cad kun 'dus yin pa la yin par shes par byas la: de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga: lte bar hrīḥljang gu: phyag zhabs bzhi la ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya bzhis mtshan par gyur: o rgyan rin po che'i gnas lnga nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kha ba bu yug ltar spyan drangs te:

byang chub sems dpa' dang dge 'dun bla ma thams cad dpral bar thim: yi dam lte bar thim: mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad gsang bar thim par gyur: zhes dang*/ gter gzhung las/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'byung= sogs nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma: zhes dang*/ gru gzings las/ rang gi spyi gtsug khru gang= sogs nas/ 'dus par gyur/ 460) zhes dang*/ mos gus rtse gcig pas/ kun bzang rigs lnga= nub phyogs= ma/ chos dbyings= ma/ rje bla ma= sogs dang*/ ma nam= bzhi skor/ rgyang 'bod tshan bdun/ khrid 'bring las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru dmyal ba'i gu ru rnam par gnon: sku mdog dmar nag rdo rje sdig pa bsnams: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal skyob par byed: pad kyi yi dwags gu ru rnam snang byed: sku mdog smug nag rdo rje lcags phur bsnams: yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal skyob par byed: ma ni byol song gu ru seng ha brtan: sku mdog mthing nag cang tel dril bu bsnams: byol song bkol spyod sdug bsngal skyob par byed: sid ni mi yi gu ru pad+ma 'byung: sku mdog dkar dmar ka li rdo rje bsnams: mi rnams skye rga na 'chi skyob par byed: dhi yi lha min gu ru rnam par rgyal: sku mdog dud kha kha ṭ+wam̐ ka li bsnams: lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal 461) skyob par byed: hūm̐ ni lha yi gu ru srid thub 'dzin: sku mdog dkar ser rdor dril phyag na bsnams: lha rnams ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sbyong bar byed: rigs drug sdug bsngal gu ru drug gis skyobs: zhes brjod/ de nas sid+dhi grangs bsag dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i= sogs nas/ thugs rjes zungs shig: zhes pa'i bar dang*/ gter gzhung las/ de la gsol ba= sogs nas/ thim par gyur: khrid 'bring las/ spyi bo'i o rgyan rin po che 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas: o rgyan rin po che'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer du gyur:

ces dang*/ gru gzings las/ spyi gtsug gu ru= sogs nas/ a la la/ zhes dang*/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma= bdag gi spyi bor= sogs dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa= sogs dang*/ skye zhing skye ba= sogs dang*/ skye ba kun tu= sogs nas/ rdo rje 462)'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog zhes brjod do/ de nas 'pho ba'i dmigs rim ni/ 'pho ba'i rgyas 'grel zur bkol ma/ rang nyid skad cig jo bo thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa zhal gcig pa: phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba: 'og ma gnyis shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang me tog pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa: zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa: dbu skra thor tshugs la rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa: dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing mtshan dang dpe byad 'od du 'bar ba gcig lam gyis sgoms shig: de yang thugs rje chen po'i sku de phyi dar dkar gyi gur phub pa lta bu la nang stong pa phru ma phus btab pa lta bu stong sang nge ba'i dbus su: rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa: bde ba mtshon pa'i phyir phyi dkar ba: gsal ba mtshon pa'i phyir nang dmar ba: byang chub kyi lam mtshon pa'i phyir 463)shin tu drang ba: ngan song gi sgo gcod pa'i phyir mar sne lte 'og tu phug rdugs su yod pa: mtho ris kyi lam bgrod pa'i phyir yar sne spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar had por yod pa: de lta bu zhig bsgom: spyi bor seng khri pad+ma zla gdan la: 'od dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag steng: lhung bzed 'dzin zhing chos gos gsol: zhabs gnyis byams bzhugs mdzad pa yi: zhabs kyi mthe bong gnyis po yis: dbu ma'i yar sne bkag par sgoms: g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: g.yas g.yon phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyi pad zlar bzhugs:

g.yon du phyag rdor mthu chen thob: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog bsngo: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i 464)stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang: nyan thos dgra bcom dpag med bskor: gtso bo gsum gyi gnas gsum gyi: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros nas: bde ba can nas spyan drangs bstim: de nas 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho: shin tu ngo mtshar 'od dpag med mgon dang: thugs rjes chen po phyag rdor mthu chen thob: bdag gis rtse gcig yid kyis gsol ba 'debs: zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs: bdag sogs nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: rnam shes bde chen 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs: gsol 'debs nyer gcig tsam/ rang gi snying ga'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang du smyug ma'i tshigs pa 'gags pa ltar du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa: de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed bkas pa tsam: de'i steng du rang gi rlung sems rnam par shes pa 'dus pa'i ngo bo thig 465)le dkar po hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas bkrag mdangs dang ldan pas mtshan pa: 'phar la khad pa yar la khad pa gcig sgoms: hrīḥde las 'od zer hrīḥyig gi rnam pa can gcig 'phros pas 'og sgo dmyal ba'i sgo khrig gis bcad: yang hrīḥgacig 'phros pas dud 'gro'i skye sgo chu'i lam khrig gis bcad: de nas hrīḥganyis 'phros te gsang gnas dang kha'i sgo yi dwags kyi skye sgo bcad: de nas hrīḥyig gcig 'phros: lte ba 'dod lha'i sgo bcad: yang hrīḥganyis 'phros: lha min dang gzugs khams dang grul bum gyi skye sgo rna ba gnyis bkag: de nas hrīḥganyis 'phros: gnod sbyin dang mi skye rga na 'chi'i skye sgo sna bug gnyis bcad: de nas hrīḥyig gsum 'phros: gzugs khams kyi skye sgo smin mtshams dang: mi'i rgyal po'i skye sgo mig g.yas g.yon rnams bkag:

yang hrī:'phros 466)mchog ma gzugs med khams kyi skye sgo bkag par sgoms: hrīḥ dmigs pa ma zin bar brjod/ de nas/ hig ces brjod pas rang sems thig le dkar po hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa de dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du 'phar nas: spyi bo'i 'od dpag med pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong la reg tsam byas: kā zhes brjod pas mar babs snying ga'i zla ba'i gdan la 'dug par sgoms: dmigs pa bzung nas/ hig ka bgrangs/ mthar/ smon lam/ e ma ho: ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang: g.yas su jo bo thugs rje chen po dang: g.yon du sems dpa' mthu chen thob rnams la: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'khor gyis bskor: bde skyid ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa yi: bde ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khams der: bdag ni 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru: de ru skyes nas snang mtha'i zhal mthong shog: de skad bdag 467) gis smon lam btab pa 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis: gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tad+ya thā: pañca dri ya a wa bho dha na ye swa hā: 'od dpag med kyi phyag gi lhung bzed nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: rang lus ltem gyis gang bar bsgom: e ma ho: rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang: thugs rje chen po mthu chen thob dang ni: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med rnams la: bdag gis gus pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhi wa ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐: tshe bsnyen brgya tsam/ 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim zhing tshangs bug haṃ dang sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag par gyur/ ces brjod do/ de nas bum dbang gi lam khyer thugs rje chen po'i bskyed bzlas ni/ rang nyid thugs rje che po ni: dkar po 468) zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa:

thal sbyar phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: skyil krung rat+na dar gyis brgyan: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ lha yi 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: pi wang pad+ma zla ba'i steng: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam: oṃ oṃ swa hā: lha min 'jig rten dbang phyug ljang: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: go mtshon pad+ma zla ba'i steng: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams: oṃ ma swa hā: mi yi 'jig rten dbang phyug khra: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: phreng ba pad+ma zla ba'i steng: skyim mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams: oṃ ṇi swa hā: dud 'gro'i 'jig rten dbang phyug dud: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: po ti pad+ma zla ba'i steng: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams: oṃ pad swa hā: yi dwags 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar: 469) zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: sgrom bu pad+ma zla ba'i steng: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams: oṃ me swa hā: dmyal ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug nag: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang: me chu pad+ma phyag na 'dzin: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam: oṃ hūm̐ swa hā: de ltar thugs rje chen po bdun gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥl yi ge drug gis bskor ba: 'khor drug gi thugs kar oṃ sogs yig 'bru re re la yig drug gis bskor bar gyur: ces brjod la ma ṇi brgya tsam bzla/ de'i bsnyen bstod ni/ 'khrul zhig dbang drag rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ hrīḥ bzang ngan gnyis med thugs rje chen po'i zhing*// med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma lta ba'i tshul// snang bzhin dag pa zhen 'dzin med pa'i ngang*// chags sdang rang grol dag pa rab 'byams zhing*// thugs rje chen po'i zhing la 470)phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ hrīḥ snang stong gnyis med thugs rje chen po'i sku// stong bzhin snang ba chu zla lta bu'i tshul// snang bzhin stong pa rgya mtsho chen po'i ngang*// snang stong rang grol dag pa rab 'byams sku// thugs rje chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ hrīḥgrags stong brjod med thugs rje chen po'i gsung*// stong bzhin grags pa brag cha lta bu'i tshul// grags bzhin stong pa brjod du med pa'i ngang*// grags stong rang grol dag pa rab 'byams gsung*// thugs rje chen po'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ hrīḥ gsal stong 'dzin med thugs rje chen pau'i thugs// stong bzhin gsal ba 'ja' tshon lta bu'i tshul// gsal bzhin stong pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang*// gsal stong rang grol dag pa rab 'byams thugs// thugs rje chen po'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ aḥ 471)hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ hrīḥ lcags sreg sa gzhi thugs rje chen po'i zhing*// a wa glang mgo thugs rje chen po'i sku// sod sod rgyob rgyob yi ge drug pa'i sgra// mda' mdung ral gri sna tshogs mchod pa'i rdzas// bde sdug rang grol dag pa rab 'byams klong*// snang srid thugs rje chen por phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ma ṇi'i dbyangs dang bcas pas thun grol/ snga thun dang*/ phyi thun/ dgong thun rnams la'ang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro/ lus gnad/ ngag gnad/ sems gnad/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa nas brtsams sngar ltar ro/ nyal khar bla ma 'od du zhu nas snying dbus bsdu/ sku mtshon gang ba 'od 'bar ba zhig bzhugs par bsam la/ snang ba'i 'du shes dang*/ ldang ba'i 'du shes dang*/ mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas nyal lo/ thun mtshams thams cad du yang sngar gyi dmigs rnam la dran shes bzhin bag yod dang ma bral bar bya/ de nas gsang dbang dang sher dbang gi lam khyer rlung dang thig le/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdzogs pa chen po ka dag dang lhun grub sogs la rim par 'jug go 472) 'di la 'bum lnga grangs tshang bar gsog na/ skyabs 'gro/ maṇ+ḍal/ yig brgya/ brkyangs phyag bcas 'bum re dang*/

kha skong khri re/ bla rnal la sid+dhi bye chen gcig bcas 'grub par bya dgos/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyangs zla chos re 'brel 'jog tsam bya na/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi la zhag gnyis te/ skyabs 'gro la gsum/ sems bskyed la gsum/ maṇ+ḍal la gsum/ rdor sems la bdun/ bla rnal la gsum/ 'pho lung la gsum bcas bya'o/ kha tshang 'jug bde zab 'dril reg pa'i phul// yud tsam myong yang ma rig 'khrul 'khor rdib// gnyug sems sangs rgyas sbar phug gtod byed pa'i// mchog bstan mdza' nas 'khor mtsho skem byed shog ces pa'ang 'dren mchog karma maṅga la bzhi pa'i thugs gsos su dpal chen che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga lam//
